tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable
The tenderer should abide by all the terms and conditions laid under standard bid document as per KTPP act
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Payment to the tenderer shall be made based on collection of property tax or financial status of CMC Hootagalli general fund
Corrigendum/Modifications/Correction if any shall be published in the website only
If any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer ,the tender shall be rejected
The tender inviting authority reserves the right to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason or whatsoever
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer are found to be misleading/forged
Tenderers are required to read the bid documents carefully before submission of their bid
Unsuccessful tenderer EMD amount will be returned after completion of successful tenderer document verification and CMC administration/council
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any state goverment/Government of India/Union territory
GPS instrument will be fixed on the tankers

Tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.15.00 lakhs.Certified turnover certificate with UDIN issued by Chartered Accountant for period 2021-22 to 2025-26
Should enclose Registration certificate if E tenderer is a firm registered proprietor/Partnership/Contractor/Public sector or private limited company
Tenderer should should have similar service work done for Rs.7.50 lakhs
The tenderer should furnish the tanker details and document such as RC book,Insurance copy

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate for the past five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 issued by CA with UDIN
Similar service work done certificate for Rs.7.50 Lakhs
Vehicle valid RC book and insurance documents
